description: This Java class 'ModelGroupReader' handles reading and caching entity group definitions from XML resources within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages entity group mappings, loads configuration files, and provides methods to retrieve group information based on entity names and delegator configurations.

classes.name: ModelGroupReader
classes.description: Handles reading, caching, and providing access to entity group definitions from XML resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModelGroupReader
methods.description: Retrieves a singleton instance of ModelGroupReader for a given delegator name, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: ModelGroupReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes resource handlers and preloads group cache based on configuration.

methods.name: getGroupCache
methods.description: Loads and caches entity group mappings from XML resources for a specific delegator.

methods.name: getEntityGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for a given entity, based on cached data or defaults.

methods.name: getGroupNames
methods.description: Returns all group names defined in the entity group configuration for a delegator.

methods.name: getEntityNamesByGroup
methods.description: Returns entity names belonging to a specified group.
